name: The Horde Needs Lean Wolf Steaks!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs Lean Wolf Steaks!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm not standing here just to get a nice tan, adventurer. There are war preparations to be made. If we're going to crush those bugs at Ahn'Qiraj then we need to be ready, and that includes food too!

They have me gathering and salting lean wolf steaks here for the upcoming war. But since I need to stay here to take care of all of this, I need you to go out, kill some wolves and then cook up the meat into lean wolf steaks and bring them back to me here. You got all that?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back with those lean wolf steaks so soon, adventurer? I don't care if they're overcooked or tartar, just make sure they're tasty and get them to me quick!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ok, this stack of meat looks good to me. I'll salt them, and then pack them away and hopefully they'll keep fresh enough to be edible when the time comes.
Thanks for the contribution, adventurer. Do you think you could bring me another rack?
